description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Eliyadivulwewa, Talawa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110109
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for various parcels in Anuradhapura District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels, their extents, owner information, and title classifications, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
